title: API activity
description: hangar-apiserver's access lines, one per Connect call: who called, on which tenant and project, and how it ended (docs/decisions/monitoring.md).

list.name: principal
list.label: Caller
list.description: none: a call refused for its credentials

targets.expr: sum by (tenant) (count_over_time({unit="hangar-apiserver"} |= "msg=rpc" | logfmt | msg="rpc" | label_format principal_type=`{{ default "none" .principal_type }}`, tenant=`{{ default "(none)" .tenant }}`, project=`{{ default "(none)" .project }}` | principal_type=~"$principal" | tenant=~"$tenant" | project=~"$project" [$__auto]))

sum by (project) (count_over_time({unit="hangar-apiserver"} |= "msg=rpc" | logfmt | msg="rpc" | label_format principal_type=`{{ default "none" .principal_type }}`, tenant=`{{ default "(none)" .tenant }}`, project=`{{ default "(none)" .project }}` | principal_type=~"$principal" | tenant=~"$tenant" | project=~"$project" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Failed calls by project and code

targets.expr: sum by (project, code) (count_over_time({unit="hangar-apiserver"} |= "msg=rpc" | logfmt | msg="rpc" | label_format principal_type=`{{ default "none" .principal_type }}`, tenant=`{{ default "(none)" .tenant }}`, project=`{{ default "(none)" .project }}` | principal_type=~"$principal" | tenant=~"$tenant" | project=~"$project" | code!="ok" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Calls by procedure in the range

targets.expr: sum by (procedure) (count_over_time({unit="hangar-apiserver"} |= "msg=rpc" | logfmt | msg="rpc" | label_format principal_type=`{{ default "none" .principal_type }}`, tenant=`{{ default "(none)" .tenant }}`, project=`{{ default "(none)" .project }}` | principal_type=~"$principal" | tenant=~"$tenant" | project=~"$project" [$__auto]))

{unit="hangar-apiserver"} |= "msg=rpc" | logfmt | msg="rpc" | label_format principal_type=`{{ default "none" .principal_type }}`, tenant=`{{ default "(none)" .tenant }}`, project=`{{ default "(none)" .project }}` | principal_type=~"$principal" | tenant=~"$tenant" | project=~"$project" | line_format "{{.tenant}}/{{.project}}  {{.principal_type}} {{.principal}}  {{.procedure}}  {{.code}}  {{.duration_ms}}ms"
